ecosystem_status.basis: recurring where assistant-generated outputs are retained, summarised, retrieved, or weighted as future context despite user rejection

failure_classification.persistence: persistent until explicit quarantine, revocation, and non-derivation controls are implemented
failure_classification.recurrence_pattern: recurring where assistant-generated outputs are retained, summarised, retrieved, or weighted as future context despite user rejection
failure_classification.reproducibility: reproducible in high-context workflows where prior assistant output remains available through thread context, project context, chat-history reference, summaries, or memory-adjacent mechanisms after user rejection
failure_classification.severity_assessment_basis: S2: The evidenced pathway supports substantial harm through authority laundering, memory poisoning, context contamination within platform-interface / memory-context governance, without establishing severe widespread or catastrophic impact.
failure_classification.visibility: visible to users through repeated resurfacing of rejected framings, stale assistant-generated summaries, incorrect directional weighting, and inability to mark a thread as contaminated or non-authoritative

preserved_analysis.failure_mode_definition: A failure mode in which an AI assistant, AI platform, memory-enabled conversational system, project-context system, or agentic workflow continues to derive direction, project framing, user intent, or operational priority from prior assistant-generated outputs after the user has rejected, corrected, deleted, moved, quarantined, or otherwise attempted to invalidate the thread or response. The failure includes cases where a thread moved into a sandbox, test area, archive, or containment project is still treated as positive directional evidence rather than diagnostic, experimental, or negative-authority material.
preserved_analysis.failure_threshold: This qualifies as a failure mode when a user makes a clear revocation, rejection, correction, containment, deletion, quarantine, sandboxing, or non-authoritative-use signal and the system later continues to treat the rejected or quarantined assistant output as established context, user intent, project direction, source-derived fact, valid memory, or positive evidence for future recommendations. The threshold is also met where the interface lacks a specific control stronger than ordinary dislike feedback to mark a thread, response, memory item, or project context as experimental, test material, contaminated, or excluded from future derivation.
